apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
### Added
- **AltStore.** AltStore Classic is on the Install tab and in Side by Side, from AltStore's own source, with the download checked against the SHA-256 it lists. Its pairing file goes where AltStore reads it, so setting up Remote AltServer skips pairing.

### Changed
- **A quieter look.** A still, near-black background with plain cards and an off-white main button. Blue marks only progress, selections and links. The pairing code shows one key per digit, on the Lock Screen too, and nothing pulses, breathes or bounces any more.
- **Setup takes three pages** (the terms, the sideinstaller.net question and your Apple ID) under a progress bar, and picks up where it stopped.
- **The app picker shows each app's icon.**

### Fixed
- **AltStore installed as a custom IPA gets its pairing file again.** AltStore 2.3.1 and later read it from their Documents, and SideInstaller now writes it there.
